title: 天人合一·前传
description: 夜晚时分，一个身穿破旧蓑衣的妖人，血洗了人间修行界的世家大族，只有三个孩子幸存下来，三个孩子长大后，为了报仇，踏上了修行之路，游历天下，苦苦寻找仇人......

chapters.title: 第三章 最后的希望

en.title: Heaven and Humanity as One · Prequel
en.description: One night, a mysterious figure in a worn straw raincoat massacres the great cultivation families. Only three children survive. Years later, they set out to cultivate, travel the world, and seek revenge.

readingGuide.genre: 修仙 · 复仇 · 成长
readingGuide.relation: 本篇从家族遭逢大灾讲起，追随三个幸存孩子的成长。《如念》是同一故事的特别篇，侧重人物情感。
readingGuide.order: 初次阅读建议从「第一章 大灾」开始，按目录阅读正文。「角色概念图」和「境界设定」是可选补充，遇到人物或修行境界时再查也可以。

en.relation: This story begins with a catastrophe and follows three surviving children. Ru Nian is a related special episode focused on the characters’ relationships.
en.order: Start with Chapter 1: Catastrophe and follow the story chapters in order. Character illustrations and cultivation realms are optional references that can be read when needed.
